### quoin-270-cli-eval-sentinel-contract

#### Claims

- The retained agent-evaluation runs show no observed pass-rate difference; this adapter does not establish causality.

#### Counterevidence

- confounder: session state and model-side nondeterminism between sequential runs (unknown)
- confounder: the treatment timeout followed omission of the required final sentinel after the task result was written (uncontrolled)
- interaction: live agent behavior and tool-selection order (uncontrolled)

#### Gaps

- the retained reports declare their schema version through this governed definition rather than an embedded report field
- the two repeats per arm are insufficient for a causal attribution
- private transcripts remain outside the tracked evidence set under the source repository content-rights policy
- one or more declared interactions or confounders are uncontrolled or unknown
- no justified attribution method was supplied

#### Owner

engineering assurance

#### Actions

- make cli-agent-evals embed its report schema version
- derive Engineering Assurance effort and transcript metadata from the runner rather than agent-authored fields
- repeat the comparison after the terminal protocol is made mechanically enforceable
